name: G36 AMG 6x6 Truck
description: The G63 AMG 6×6 is a luxury six-wheel off-road vehicle crafted by AMG, renowned for its formidable off-road capability and lavish interior. It is powered by a 5.5-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine delivering 544 horsepower. The vehicle features a three-axle six-wheel drive system, portal axles, and a tire pressure adjustment system.
